description: Revit audit checks, one or more per mistake of references/practice/mistakes-revit.md (ids keep the mistake id as their first part: rv-001.*). Facts tables and new evaluators are specified in FACTS.md.

checks.title: In-place families are reported with their count
checks.why: Each in-place copy is a separate definition that bloats the model and cannot become a loadable family. Practitioners treat any number as a smell; the project sets the gate.

fix.instructions: Replace repeated in-place families with loadable families in the right category.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-001 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S35 S36 S22 S37, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Autodesk Model Analytics counts in-place families but publishes no threshold [S24]

checks.title: No in-place family is in Generic Models
checks.why: Generic Models are missing from category schedules, tags and filters and export to IFC as proxies.

fix.instructions: Recategorise the in-place family (Family Category and Parameters) or rebuild it as a loadable family in the right category.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-002 (detection: Auto); sources S22 S70, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Warnings are reported by type with their counts
checks.why: Ignored warnings slow the model and hide errors; practitioners cite 700 to 1,000+ as harmful [S23][S39] and thousands as the problem level [S36]. Fixing the largest types first is fastest.

fix.instructions: Triage by type: fix the largest groups first; review ramp, stair and room warnings at once.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-003 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S35 S36 S39, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. No authoritative threshold; the project sets max per type

checks.title: No room separation line overlaps a wall
checks.why: Overlapping separation lines make room boundaries ambiguous and are among the commonest warnings.

params.pattern: .*wall and a room separation line overlap.*

fix.instructions: Delete the room separation line named in the warning (the wall already bounds the room), after confirming.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-004 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S39, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Matches the English warning text; engines should also set failureDefinitionId

checks.title: Mark values are unique within each category
checks.why: Duplicate marks make schedules and tags ambiguous.

fix.note: Fill Mark with the next free number in the project's scheme before running.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-005 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S39, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Room numbers are unique
checks.why: Duplicate room numbers break room schedules, door numbering and finish schedules.

fix.note: Fill Number from the project's numbering scheme before running.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-005 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S39 S75, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: No element is slightly off axis
checks.why: Elements a fraction of a degree off axis make joins, dimensions and rooms misbehave.

fix.instructions: Rotate or redraw the element to the exact angle (the warning names it).

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-006 (detection: Auto); sources S39, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: No view hides elements one by one
checks.why: Elements hidden in view are invisible state others cannot see or manage; filters and templates should control visibility.

fix.instructions: Reveal hidden elements in the view and control visibility with filters or the view template.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-007 (detection: Auto); sources S37 S34 S47 S91, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Drawings are not faked with overrides and filled regions
checks.why: Overrides and filled regions over the model make drawings differ from the model.

params.instructions: Review per-element graphic overrides and filled regions over model elements; fix the model or the type instead.

fix.instructions: Review per-element graphic overrides and filled regions over model elements; fix the model or the type instead.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-008 (detection: Heur); sources S47, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Text notes do not imitate tags
checks.why: A typed door or room number goes stale when the element changes.

fix.instructions: Replace the text note with a tag of the element it names.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-009 (detection: Heur); sources S34 S38, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Text that is only a mark or number, such as 101 or D-12; severity capped for a heuristic

checks.title: Plan notes are keynotes or schedule-driven, not text legends
checks.why: Numbered text legends get out of step with the notes they number.

params.instructions: Review legends with numbered text notes and the absence of keynote tags.

fix.instructions: Review legends with numbered text notes and the absence of keynote tags.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-010 (detection: Heur); sources S34, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Model elements are modelled, not drawn with detail lines
checks.why: Detail lines drawing walls or stairs are absent from 3D, schedules and coordination.

params.instructions: Review plan views for detail or model lines forming stair or wall patterns.

fix.instructions: Review plan views for detail or model lines forming stair or wall patterns.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-011 (detection: Heur); sources S34, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: CAD is linked, not imported
checks.why: Imported CAD brings junk styles, memory load and corruption risk.

fix.instructions: Delete the import (with approval) and link the file instead, on the CAD link workset.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-012 (detection: Auto); sources S22 S35 S36 S34 S37, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: No exploded CAD in the project
checks.why: Exploding CAD creates hundreds of line styles, fill patterns and text types.

params.instructions: Compare line style, fill pattern and text type counts (document facts) with the office template; look for names matching DWG layer names.

fix.instructions: Compare line style, fill pattern and text type counts (document facts) with the office template; look for names matching DWG layer names.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-013 (detection: Auto); sources S34 S36, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Kept manual: the signal is a spike against the template, and the template is not in the model

checks.title: CAD links use relative paths
checks.why: Absolute paths break when the project moves.

fix.instructions: Reload the link with a relative path (Manage Links).

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-014 (detection: Auto); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: CAD links are pinned
checks.why: An unpinned link moves with one accidental drag.

fix.instructions: Pin the link after checking its position.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-014 (detection: Auto); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: CAD links are on the CAD link workset
checks.why: A link on another workset cannot be unloaded or hidden with the other links.

fix.note: Set workset to the project's CAD link workset (patterns.cadLinkWorkset).

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-014 (detection: Auto); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Revit links are placed per the agreed basis
checks.why: Links placed on the wrong basis give a misaligned federated model.

params.instructions: Compare each link's position with the BEP: shared coordinates or origin to origin [S22]; check with the BIM coordinator.

fix.instructions: Compare each link's position with the BEP: shared coordinates or origin to origin [S22]; check with the BIM coordinator.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-015 (detection: Heur); sources S22 S28, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Each Revit link is on its own workset
checks.why: Links sharing a workset cannot be loaded and unloaded separately.

fix.note: Give the link a workset of its own, named per the project convention.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-015 (detection: Heur); sources S22 S28, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Automatic for the workset part; severity error as for rv-015.revit-link-path

checks.title: Revit links use relative paths
checks.why: Absolute paths break when the project moves.

fix.instructions: Reload the link with a relative path (Manage Links).

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-015 (detection: Heur); sources S22 S28, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Automatic for the path part; severity error because a wrong path is a major problem, the critical placement part is rv-015.link-placement

checks.title: Model geometry is within 20 miles (32 km) of the internal origin
checks.why: Geometry far from the origin loses precision and breaks graphics and coordinates.

fix.instructions: Relocate with the BIM coordinator; never move a shared model unasked.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-016 (detection: Auto); sources S27 S34, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. 20 miles is the Autodesk figure [S27]; 32,186,880 mm

checks.title: Levels and grids are pinned
checks.why: An unpinned grid or level moved by accident shifts the whole model.

fix.instructions: Pin the level or grid after checking its position against the structural model.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-017 (detection: Auto); sources S34 S45, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: 'Drag elements on selection' is off
checks.why: With it on, a click can move an element.

params.instructions: UI setting: ask the user to turn it off (status bar). It is not stored in the model.

fix.instructions: UI setting: ask the user to turn it off (status bar). It is not stored in the model.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-018 (detection: UI); sources S34, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Worksets are few and not used like layers
checks.why: Many layer-like worksets add complexity without benefit.

params.instructions: Review the workset list against the project norm; consolidate and use filters and templates for visibility.

fix.instructions: Review the workset list against the project norm; consolidate and use filters and templates for visibility.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-019 (detection: Heur); sources S34, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Furniture is on the FF&E workset
checks.why: Elements on the wrong workset load and display wrongly and need the wrong permissions.

fix.note: Set workset to the FF&E workset; the element must be owned by the user or available.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-020 (detection: Heur); sources S22 S75, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Only the furniture rule is automatic; other category-to-workset rules are project-specific

checks.title: Elements are in the right phase and link phases are mapped
checks.why: Wrong phases show existing and new work wrongly and give wrong quantities.

params.instructions: Review Phase Created and Demolished against the view phases; check phase mapping for every link.

fix.instructions: Review Phase Created and Demolished against the view phases; check phase mapping for every link.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-021 (detection: Heur); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Design option sets are reported
checks.why: Options left after the decision cost computation and confuse the team; whether options are still live depends on the stage.

fix.instructions: When the option is decided, accept the primary and delete the option set, with the user's approval.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-022 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S36, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Model and detail group instances are reported with their count
checks.why: Groups add overhead and odd behaviour, especially arrays left grouped; the project sets the gate.

fix.instructions: Ungroup where groups are not needed for repetition.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-023 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S35 S36 S25, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. No sourced threshold

checks.title: No unused group types
checks.why: Unused group types are dead weight that purge removes.

fix.instructions: Purge unused group types (Purge Unused) after confirming none is kept for later use.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-023 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S35 S36 S25, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: No locked dimensions or constraints in the project
checks.why: Project-level locks add recalculation overhead and constraint errors.

params.instructions: Review locked dimension constraints and 'constraints are not satisfied' warnings; remove project-level locks.

fix.instructions: Review locked dimension constraints and 'constraints are not satisfied' warnings; remove project-level locks.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-024 (detection: Heur); sources S23 S35 S36 S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Families and elements are not over-modelled
checks.why: Modelling detail that drawings do not need costs file weight and time.

params.instructions: Review large families and tiny solids (under about 100 mm / 4 in, practitioner guidance [S34]); simplify with symbolic lines and detail levels.

fix.instructions: Review large families and tiny solids (under about 100 mm / 4 in, practitioner guidance [S34]); simplify with symbolic lines and detail levels.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-025 (detection: Heur); sources S34 S35 S36, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Downloaded and manufacturer families are vetted
checks.why: Unvetted content brings bloat, junk and advertising parameters.

params.instructions: Review large family files, high parameter counts and non-standard parameter names; clean or replace with office content.

fix.instructions: Review large family files, high parameter counts and non-standard parameter names; clean or replace with office content.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-026 (detection: Heur); sources S34 S35, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Type names carry no copy suffixes
checks.why: Types like 'Wall 2 2' are duplicates nobody renamed; people pick the wrong one.

fix.instructions: Rename the type to the naming standard, or merge it into the original type and purge it.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-027 (detection: Auto); sources S37, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Matches repeated trailing numbers and 'copy'; a single trailing number is too often legitimate to flag

checks.title: Views have project names, not default or copy names
checks.why: 'Section 1' and 'Copy of' views pile up and nobody knows which is live.

fix.note: Give the name from the project's view naming convention.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-028 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S35 S34, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. English default names; localised Revit versions need their own pattern

checks.title: Views not on sheets are reported with their count
checks.why: Working views accumulate and add weight; the project decides how many to keep.

fix.note: The count finding has no record id: fill ids from the views table (onSheet false) and get approval first.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-028 (detection: Auto); sources S23 S35 S34 S46, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Views on sheets have a view template
checks.why: Without templates, graphics on sheets differ view by view.

fix.note: Set template to the project's template for this view type.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-029 (detection: Auto); sources S91 S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Walls span no more than two levels
checks.why: Walls through many levels update slowly and associate with the wrong level.

fix.instructions: Split the wall at levels (with the user's approval).

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-030 (detection: Auto); sources S31 S25 S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. The two-level figure is from one published custom checkset [S31]; the project sets the limit

checks.title: Elements are within 200 mm of their host level
checks.why: Elements far off their level break schedules by level and coordination.

fix.instructions: Re-host the element to the right level, keeping its position.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-031 (detection: Auto); sources S31 S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. 200 mm is from one published custom checkset [S31]; the project sets the limit

checks.title: Wall openings are not used in place of windows
checks.why: An opening has no window data and is missing from schedules.

params.instructions: Review wall openings with no hosted door or window.

fix.instructions: Review wall openings with no hosted door or window.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-032 (detection: Heur); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Curtain wall doors use curtain panel door families
checks.why: Ordinary doors substituted into curtain panels behave and schedule wrongly.

params.instructions: Review doors in curtain wall panel positions that are not the project's curtain door family.

fix.instructions: Review doors in curtain wall panel positions that are not the project's curtain door family.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-033 (detection: Heur); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Walls are not attached to floors or roofs where the owner forbids it
checks.why: Attached walls create dependencies the owner standard forbids.

fix.instructions: Detach the wall and set its constraints or profile; only where the owner rule applies.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-034 (detection: Auto); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. An owner rule (NY OGS), not a universal one

checks.title: No mass instances in the documentation model
checks.why: Masses used for real elements are missing from the right schedules and categories.

fix.instructions: Replace the mass with the proper element; delete massing studies at documentation stages with the user's approval.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-035 (detection: Auto); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Severity info: whether masses are still legitimate depends on the project stage, which the model does not record

checks.title: Elements are modified, not deleted and redrawn
checks.why: Redrawing loses element identity and orphans hosted items.

params.instructions: Compare element ids between versions and look for orphaned hosted elements.

fix.instructions: Compare element ids between versions and look for orphaned hosted elements.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-036 (detection: Heur); sources S36, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Every room is placed, enclosed and not redundant
checks.why: Unplaced, unenclosed and redundant rooms give wrong areas and 'Not Enclosed' in schedules.

fix.note: Destructive and only for unplaced rooms, with the user's approval; close boundaries for not enclosed rooms instead.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-037 (detection: Auto); sources S79, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: One space per room
checks.why: Several spaces in one room give wrong loads.

fix.instructions: Report to the MEP author; delete duplicate spaces only in your own model, with approval.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-038 (detection: Auto); sources S75, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Unassigned MEP components are not checked: outside architecture and interiors scope

checks.title: Families are in the right category
checks.why: A wrong category hides elements from schedules, tags, filters and IFC/COBie mapping.

params.instructions: Run a 'Generic Models - To Reclassify' and a multi-category schedule [S70]; compare categories with names.

fix.instructions: Run a 'Generic Models - To Reclassify' and a multi-category schedule [S70]; compare categories with names.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-039 (detection: Heur); sources S70, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Nested families that must be scheduled are shared
checks.why: Non-shared nested families cannot be tagged or scheduled.

params.instructions: Review families whose sub-components appear in schedules; make the nested family shared and reload.

fix.instructions: Review families whose sub-components appear in schedules; make the nested family shared and reload.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-040 (detection: Heur); sources S69, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: No orphaned families or types from copy and paste
checks.why: Pasting between projects leaves renamed duplicates.

params.instructions: Look for families and types with '1' or '2' suffixes after pasting; merge to the original types and purge.

fix.instructions: Look for families and types with '1' or '2' suffixes after pasting; merge to the original types and purge.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-041 (detection: Heur); sources S75, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Repeated-number suffixes are also reported by rv-027

checks.title: Loaded families with no instances are reported
checks.why: An over-populated template or project carries families nobody uses.

fix.instructions: Purge unused families with the user's approval; keep annotation families the template needs.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-042 (detection: Auto); sources S36 S25, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. No sourced threshold

checks.title: Users synchronise and relinquish regularly
checks.why: Borrowed elements block others and unsynchronised work is lost.

params.instructions: Review elements owned by inactive users and the sync history; advise the user. Never sync or relinquish unasked.

fix.instructions: Review elements owned by inactive users and the sync history; advise the user. Never sync or relinquish unasked.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-043 (detection: Heur); sources S29 S87, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: The whole team is on the same Revit build
checks.why: Mixed builds cause worksharing problems.

params.instructions: Read the build numbers in the central model's worksharing log (.slog) or ask the BIM manager.

fix.instructions: Read the build numbers in the central model's worksharing log (.slog) or ask the BIM manager.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-044 (detection: Auto); sources S28, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Kept manual: the build history is in a log file beside the central model, not in the model

checks.title: Linear dimension types display no finer than a buildable precision
checks.why: Revit's 1/256 in default shows a precision nobody can build.

fix.instructions: Set the dimension type's Units Format rounding to 1/2 in (1/4 in at most) or whole millimetres; see dimensions-annotation.md section 4.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-045 (detection: Auto); sources S49, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. The guide's target is 1/2 in; the check fails only below 1/4 in, which S49 allows occasionally

checks.title: Text notes and detail items are in views, not on sheets
checks.why: Notes placed on the sheet detach from the view they describe when views move.

fix.instructions: Move the note into the view it describes; sheet-wide general notes may stay on the sheet if the standard allows.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-046 (detection: Auto); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Severity info: sheet-level general notes are legitimate (drawing-conventions.md section 7)

checks.title: No entourage or planting is visible in views on sheets
checks.why: Entourage clutters construction documents and slows them.

fix.instructions: Hide the Entourage and Planting categories in the documentation template, or put them on a workset closed by default.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-047 (detection: Auto); sources S34, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Imported raster images are reported with their count
checks.why: Images count against model health and slow the model.

fix.instructions: Remove unused images (Manage Images).

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-048 (detection: Auto); sources S24 S23 S25, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Autodesk Model Analytics counts images but publishes no threshold [S24]

checks.title: Plan regions are reported with their count
checks.why: Plan regions count against model health and slow views.

fix.instructions: Merge or remove plan regions that are not needed.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-048 (detection: Auto); sources S24 S23 S25, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Copy/Monitor coordination alerts are resolved
checks.why: Ignored alerts let levels and grids drift between disciplines.

params.instructions: Open Coordination Review and resolve each pending item.

fix.instructions: Open Coordination Review and resolve each pending item.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-049 (detection: Heur); sources S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Received models are parametric and tagged, not drawn
checks.why: Families with no type parameters and text in place of tags cannot be scheduled or maintained.

params.instructions: Review families with no type parameters and text notes next to untagged elements; report to the sender.

fix.instructions: Review families with no type parameters and text notes next to untagged elements; report to the sender.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-050 (detection: Heur); sources S38, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: IFC export views are at Fine detail level
checks.why: Elements shown only at Fine are silently missing from an IFC exported from a Coarse or Medium view.

fix.instructions: Set the export view's detail level to Fine (or export from a Fine 3D export view).

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-051 (detection: Auto); sources S59 S22, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Export views are found by name (patterns.ifcExportView), a convention, so the check is a heuristic; raise severity when the project names export views by that rule

checks.title: The IFC export has no unintended proxies or NOTDEFINED types
checks.why: Downstream tools cannot classify proxies.

params.instructions: Open the exported IFC and count IfcBuildingElementProxy and NOTDEFINED; map categories and IFC classes.

fix.instructions: Open the exported IFC and count IfcBuildingElementProxy and NOTDEFINED; map categories and IFC classes.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-052 (detection: Auto); sources S59 S14 S58, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Generic Model types have an IFC export class
checks.why: Generic models without an IFC class export as IfcBuildingElementProxy and cannot be classified downstream.

fix.instructions: Set the type's IfcExportAs (and IfcExportType) to the right IFC class and predefined type, or recategorise the family.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-052 (detection: Auto); sources S59 S14 S58, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Proxy and NOTDEFINED counts in an export file are a separate review

checks.title: The warning total is within the project's issue gate
checks.why: Issuing with warnings above the gate gives poor deliverables and fails BIM manager audits.

fix.instructions: Set the project's gate in this check's max, raise severity to error, and triage before issue.

checks.source: mistakes-revit.md RV-053 (detection: Auto); sources S84 S36, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Ships with max 0 so the total is always reported; the project sets its gate
